verdict.rationale: WooCommerce documents an official WC-CLI for managing stores via command line (woocommerce-docs-13, woocommerce-probe-4), and separately ships native MCP support enabling AI assistants to interact with stores (woocommerce-docs-14/29/probe-3), which together satisfy the 'official CLI for AI-native workflows' story. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of CLI usage in AI-agent workflows, and no explicit documentation tying the CLI itself to AI-native tooling (MCP is separate from CLI).
